assumptions.native: Uses current public USE_ITEM/DOMAIN_START/COMBAT transactions and native addXp for isolated lifecycle boundaries. No combat/heal/XP behavior is replaced.
assumptions.fixtures: Declared ownership, legal level/phase/talents/gear, HP and XP immediately before a level boundary are diagnostic fixtures. No real player save or live account is changed.
assumptions.labels: Native combat heals, combat-end HP clipping, level-up HP, explicit protagonist victory revival and inn quotation are kept separate. A book is an item cost and not described as free.
